security_rule: Only operate inside an explicit authorised bounty scope after scope and rules are verified.
eligibility_rule: Do not impersonate licensed professionals or submit where the user is ineligible.
truth_rule: Never describe a discovered reward as revenue. Revenue requires PAYOUT_VERIFIED evidence.
quality_rule: Do not submit low-quality spam. Every solution must pass the target's objective acceptance checks where available.
self_modification_rule: A reflection may propose changes, but production strategy/code changes require external evaluation against a baseline.
